name: Beta RR 250 / 300 two-stroke
engine: 249 or 293 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke single, oil injection or premix, carb or injection
intro: Beta's two-stroke enduros. Many have oil injection, so check the system before you mix fuel.

B: Many Beta RRs have oil injection. Check for an oil tank and pump; if it has been removed, it needs premix.

recallNote: Off-road and trials models are often not in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a dealer for the make to run the frame number.
